headline: Maui County Committee on Persons with Disabilities

meeting.body: Maui County Committee on Persons with Disabilities
meeting.summary: With only four members present at first, the commission agreed to hear presentations but not vote.
meeting.recap: With only four members present at first, the commission agreed to hear presentations but not vote.[[0:01:57]] Approval of past meeting minutes was put off because there was no quorum, the minimum number of members needed to act.[[0:12:00]] The company said shutoffs depend on drought, wind gusts of 45 miles per hour or more, and humidity below 45%.[[0:27:29]] People who rely on powered medical equipment were urged to fill out a medical needs form.[[0:32:58]] The Planning Department is set to present the plan to the commission in December.[[0:57:54]] The next meeting is December 12 at 12:30 p.m.[[1:32:09]]
meeting.next: The Planning Department is set to present the draft recovery plan and take commission feedback in December. Commissioners were asked to review the draft plan and note comments to help draft a letter. Staff will keep following up with the mayor's office on the elections special needs advisory committee. Staff said the County plans to move video meetings from WebEx to Microsoft Teams.
